The '''Imperial Outpost DNT-X004''' was an Imperial recon base on the planet [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] during the [[Dantooine Incursion]].<ref name="Codex" />

==Description==
Imperial Outpost DNT-X004 was an outpost of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]. It was hidden in a [[Cave/Legends|cave]] strategically located near the [[Banir Regional Energy Complex]]. The location proved to be a perfect launchpad for strikes on [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] infrastructure. The Imperials and [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] operated with a minimum of staff and materiel.<ref name="Codex" />
